学英语可以从每周能稳定到场的一门课开始。先写下目标：买菜看病时能沟通、工作中敢开: Start with one English class you can attend consistently each week. Decide whether your goal is everyday appointments and shopping, speaking at work or preparing for college study, then choose a school convenient to home or work. These are places to start your search, not a promise of available seats. Start with one school; regular attendance matters more than signing up for several classes.
Noncredit 通常指非学分课程，不等于随到随上，也不自动换成学位学分；cr: Noncredit courses generally do not award academic credit. They still require enrollment and do not automatically convert to degree credit. Credit courses may support further study; ask a counselor how they apply to a particular program. CCSF’s free noncredit classes have their own residence and admission conditions, separate from Free City. Check age, application requirements and eligibility with every school.
